whatIs.title: What is Misbah
whatIs.description: Misbah is an online directory that brings together teachers of the Holy Quran, Arabic language, and Islamic studies in one place.
whatIs.subDescription: We display contact information for each teacher, allowing students or parents to reach out directly outside the platform.

why.title: Why Misbah was Created
why.description: Many excellent teachers lack a clear digital presence, and many students search for a suitable teacher without knowing where to start.
why.subDescription: Misbah bridges this gap: we provide an organized space that presents teachers professionally and allows students to reach them easily.

how.title: How Misbah Works
steps: The teacher creates an introductory profile with their information and experience.
The application is manually reviewed to ensure seriousness and accuracy of basic information.
After publishing, the profile becomes publicly available and can appear in search engines.

nature.title: What is Misbah's Nature
points: Not an educational platform — we don't manage lessons or provide content.
Not a financial intermediary — we don't handle payments or fees.
Not an accreditation body — we don't grant certificates or validate credentials.
Not a booking platform — we don't manage appointments or schedules.
nature.conclusion: We are simply a directory: we display information and leave the decision of contact and choice to the student.

review.title: What We Review
review.description: We review each application to ensure: completion of basic information, clarity of specialization and experience, and seriousness of the applicant. However, we do not independently verify certificates or credentials, nor do we guarantee teaching quality.

limits.title: Limits of Our Responsibility
limits.description: Misbah bears no responsibility for teaching quality, any financial transactions, or any disputes that arise between student and teacher. The relationship between them is completely independent of the platform.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions or feedback, you can reach us at:

items.question: What is Misbah?
items.answer: Misbah is an online directory that displays teachers of the Holy Quran, Arabic language, and Islamic studies, with contact information for each teacher.

items.question: Is Misbah an educational platform?
items.answer: No. Misbah is not an educational platform. We only display teacher information. Lessons and communication happen directly between student and teacher outside the site.

items.question: Is Misbah responsible for teaching quality?
items.answer: No. Misbah does not guarantee teaching quality and bears no responsibility for the relationship between student and teacher.

items.question: Does Misbah handle payments?
items.answer: No. Any financial arrangement between student and teacher is completely independent of Misbah.

items.question: How can I join as a teacher?
items.answer: You can apply through the registration page. We'll review your application and contact you.

items.question: Are there fees for students?
items.answer: No. Browsing and accessing teacher information is completely free for students.

items.question: Are there fees for teachers?
items.answer: Yes, there is a symbolic annual subscription for teachers after their application is accepted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summaryText: We collect the minimum data necessary to operate the directory, and we do not share it for marketing purposes.
privacy.dataCollectionTeachers: For Teachers: Name, country, subjects, experience, contact methods, video URL
privacy.usageText: We use data to display profiles and improve experience. We do not sell data to third parties.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.summaryText: Misbah is a directory displaying contact information for independent teachers. No education or communication happens within the site. Any communication happens externally at the parties' responsibility.
terms.natureText: Misbah is NOT: an educational platform, booking platform, financial intermediary, accreditation body, or communication platform.
terms.responsibilitySimple1: Student is responsible for verifying teacher suitability
terms.responsibilitySimple2: Teacher is responsible for accuracy of their information
terms.responsibilitySimple3: Any agreement between parties is their responsibility
terms.subscriptionText: Teachers pay a symbolic annual subscription (clarified during application). Browsing is free for students.
terms.modificationText: Teacher has the right to request profile deletion. We have the right to remove any violating profile.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.highlightText: Misbah only displays contact information. Any communication or agreement between the student and the teacher happens outside the site at their own responsibility. Misbah is not legally or educationally responsible.
disclaimer.scopeComm: Communication: Happens outside the site, we do not monitor or intervene in it
disclaimer.scopeInfo: Information: Provided by teachers, we have not independently verified it
disclaimer.scopeEdu: Education: We do not guarantee its quality or results
disclaimer.scopeMoney: Money: We do not intervene in any financial agreements between parties
disclaimer.reviewText: We review applications only to ensure seriousness. The review is not an academic evaluation and does not grant accreditation.
disclaimer.agreementText: By using Misbah, you agree to bear full responsibility for any communication or agreement that takes place between you and any teacher.
